name: Haus Beer Nebenhaus
beschreibung:
Serving as a peaceful annex in Ellmau, Haus Beer Nebenhaus features spacious, well-maintained apartments showcasing lovely views across alpine meadows and the Wilder Kaiser.

The Hartkaiserbahn cable car base terminal and KaiserBad Ellmau are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Beer Nebenhaus in Ellmau provides sunny holiday flats at the base of the Tyrolean peaks.
